title: Chapter 12 Revision: Aspect Basics
description: Mixed questions covering perfective vs. imperfective concept, common aspect pairs, prefix patterns, and aspect in context.

questions.prompt: Codziennie ___ gazety. (I read newspapers every day — habitual.) [czytać/przeczytać, ja m]
questions.explanation: 'Codziennie' (every day) = habitual → imperfective past: czytałem. 'Przeczytałem' = I finished reading [a specific newspaper] — not habitual.

questions.prompt: W końcu ___ raport. (I finally wrote the report.) [pisać/napisać, ja m]
questions.explanation: 'W końcu' (finally) signals completed result → perfective: napisałem. Imperfective 'pisałem' only says 'I was writing' without completion.

questions.prompt: What is the perfective partner of 'kupować'?
questions.explanation: 'Kupować' (imperf) → 'kupić' (perf). A stem-change pair, not prefix-based. 'Kupiłem' = I bought [one completed purchase].

questions.prompt: What does 'pójść' mean and what is its imperfective?
questions.explanation: 'Pójść' = perfective of 'iść' (to go on foot). 'Poszłam do sklepu' = I went to the shop (completed).
'Posprzątać' = perfective of 'sprzątać'. The po- prefix here perfectivizes the verb. 'Posprzątałam pokój' = I cleaned the room (finished).

questions.prompt: Nagle ___ hałas. (Suddenly I heard a noise.) [słyszeć/usłyszeć, ja m]
questions.explanation: 'Nagle' (suddenly) + single sudden event → perfective: usłyszałem. 'Słyszałem' = I was hearing (ongoing, background).

questions.prompt: Which of these CANNOT be used in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Perfective verbs like 'napisać' have NO true present tense. Their present-looking form (napiszę) is actually FUTURE. Only imperfective verbs can express present tense.

questions.prompt: What is the perfective form of 'widzieć' (to see)?
questions.explanation: 'Widzieć' (imperf) → 'zobaczyć' (perf). Completely different prefix pattern — must be memorized. 'Zobaczyłem go wczoraj' = I saw him yesterday.

questions.prompt: Kiedy ___ kolację, zadzwonił telefon. (While I was eating dinner, the phone rang.) [jeść, ja f]
questions.explanation: 'Kiedy' + background ongoing action = imperfective: jadłam. 'Zjadłam' would mean a completed dinner event — doesn't work as background here.

questions.prompt: Zadzwoniłem do niej o dziewiątej. Which prefix perfectivizes 'dzwonić'?
questions.explanation: 'Za-' + dzwonić = 'zadzwonić' (perfective: to call/phone [once]). 'Zadzwoniłem' = I called [completed single call].

questions.prompt: Choose the correct pair for: 'First I paid, then I left.' [sequential events — perfective]
questions.explanation: Sequential completed events → both perfective: zapłaciłem (paid) + wyszedłem (left). Two completed steps in narrative sequence.
'Niedokonany' = imperfective (literally: 'not completed'). Contrast: 'dokonany' = perfective (completed). These are the Polish grammar terms.
